phrase.zh: 细看那一点差别，世界便多了一种认识。
phrase.en: A closer look at a small difference reveals something new.

visual.zh: 左侧立式铜色椭圆框包围一粗一细两条暗红竖线，右侧为大片深绿留白；细刻线沿框边排布。中性黑白版保留相同构图，以浅灰竖线区别暗色背景。
visual.en: At left an upright copper-colored oval frame surrounds one broad and one fine dark-red vertical mark; a broad deep-green field remains quiet at right. Fine hatching follows the frame. Neutral monochrome preserves the arrangement with pale-gray marks against a dark ground.

background.zh:
尤里因发现重氢获得1934年诺贝尔化学奖。重氢也叫氘，是氢的一种较重同位素：仍是氢，但原子核中多一个中子。1931年，他与合作者通过氢的光谱寻找这种差别。铜框内一粗一细的竖线取意于光谱辨认，是原创插画，不是实测光谱、波长刻度或原用仪器；短句为原创。
1934年化学奖；独享本年度奖项。获奖理由（中文译述）：发现重氢。
background.en:
Urey received the 1934 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for discovering heavy hydrogen. Also called deuterium, it is a heavier isotope of hydrogen: still hydrogen, but with an additional neutron in its nucleus. In 1931 he and collaborators used hydrogen spectra to identify the difference. The broad and fine upright marks inside a copper frame draw on spectral observation. This is original artwork, not a measured spectrum, wavelength scale or historical instrument. The phrase is original.
1934 — The Nobel Prize in Chemistry. Received the full prize. Official motivation: for his discovery of heavy hydrogen
